config.screen.dnp.title: Damage Number Particles Config
config.widget.dnp.self_particle.descript: If enabled, particles will be shown for damage/healing dealt to yourself.
config.widget.dnp.damage_threshold.descr: The maximum health change value used for color scaling. Higher values will make colors change less dramatically for the same health change.
config.widget.dnp.particle_radius.descri: The maximum distance from the player that particles will be rendered.
config.widget.dnp.blacklist.description: A list of entity types for which damage number particles will not be displayed. Use resource locations (e.g., 'minecraft:zombie').
